body: It Is Possible to Be Temptec, We can be tempted by so many things inside of ourselves and outside of ourselves. This is why it is so important that our interest must be in Freedom alone. Many people think that after they have realized who they are, it would be impossible for them to go back to the old way of being. They think that it would be impossible to be tempted by their old way of seeing. Even after Realization it is shockingly easy for people to slip right back into old ways of seeing and being without even realizing that they have done so. That's why you have to be very careful. Realize choicelessness and you will be careful. 2 5 4
